primitives.note: Prowling Projectile deals its TotalMissileDamage on hit; since no ally exists in the fight, Yuumi is never attached, so it never reaches the channeled/accelerated damage tier or the Best Friend on-hit bonus.
Mana costs (Q 50-75, E 80-120, R 100) against Yuumi's modest mana pool can limit how many casts land inside the 15s window.

Zoomies grants Yuumi (unattached, since no ally exists to redirect it to) bonus attack speed for 3s, raising her basic-attack DPS; its shield only matters for damage taken (survival fight), not the damage fight.
Final Chapter channels for up to 3.5s; per the wiki's channel-interaction table, Prowling Projectile is disabled (locked out) for that duration.
Final Chapter fires 5 separately-timed wave hits roughly 0.75s apart within one cast, not a single damage instance.
Waves after the first that hit the same target deal only 25% of the base per-wave damage, so R's total depends on how many of the 5 waves actually connect with the dummy.

needsBespoke.why: Yuumi's damage-relevant kit reduces to a narrow subset once the fight rules are applied literally: her passive (Feline Friendship) and W (You and Me!) are entirely built around having an allied Anchor, which does not exist in either fight (no allies). With no ally, Q never channels/accelerates and never gets the Best Friend on-hit bonus, so it is a plain-cast. R is a channelled, 5-part, self-damage-decaying ability that recast-or-multipart plus conditional-damage capture directly. E is a simple timed self-buff (attack speed) once redirected to herself. No logic outside the closed primitive list is needed to express this.

unsettled.question: Should the damage-fight simulator treat Yuumi as permanently attached to a phantom ally (so that Prowling Projectile reaches its channeled/accelerated damage tier and Best Friend on-hit bonus applies), or strictly as unattached the whole fight since the fight rules state there are no allies?
options: Strict reading: no allies exist, so Yuumi is always unattached and Q only ever deals its base (non-empowered) missile damage with no on-hit bonus
Simulator assumes a permanent phantom Anchor so Q's channeled/accelerated damage (up to 355+30%AP vs 235+20%AP) and Best Friend on-hit magic damage apply every cast
quotes: '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} briefly to steer the missile, after which it accelerates to deal increased damage and apply a stronger slow to champions.
Always applies the stronger {{tip|slow}} and grants her ''Best Friend'' bonus on-hit damage for a few seconds.

unsettled.question: Do all 5 of Final Chapter's waves actually connect with a single stationary target dummy, or does the moving-wave geometry mean fewer waves land?
options: All 5 waves hit the stationary dummy every cast (full damage on wave 1, 25% on waves 2-5)
Only the first wave is guaranteed to hit; subsequent wave connections depend on positioning/travel mechanics the dossier does not fully specify for a stationary dummy
quotes: '''Yuumi''' and '''{{ui|Book of Thresholds|Book|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|channel}} for up to {{fd|3.5}} seconds ... to launch 5 magical waves in the target direction.
The VFX will follow '''Yuumi's''' location, but the actual hitbox of each wave won't.

proposal: Open by casting Zoomies (E) on Yuumi herself for bonus attack speed (no ally exists to redirect it to), boosting basic-attack DPS for the rest of the fight.
Cast Prowling Projectile (Q) on cooldown (6.5s) at its base, unattached damage, since no ally exists to trigger the channeled/accelerated tier.

Cast Final Chapter (R) once, ideally early since its cooldown (100-120s) means only one cast fits in the 15s window; during its up-to-3.5s channel, Q is locked out per the channel-interaction table, so pause Q casts during this window.
Resume casting Q on cooldown as soon as R's channel ends.
Continue autoattacking the dummy between ability casts to add base AD damage, refreshed by E's attack-speed buff.
Recast Zoomies (E) again if it comes off cooldown (10s) before the fight ends, to maintain the attack-speed buff.
Do not use You and Me! (W): it has no valid target since no allies exist in either fight.
questions: Should the sim treat Yuumi as attached to a phantom ally for the whole fight (enabling Q's channeled/Best Friend tiers), or strictly unattached per the no-allies fight rule?
Does the damage fight count Yuumi's basic attacks at all, given her very low base AD, or is the intended rotation ability-only?
Should Final Chapter be cast immediately at the start of the 15s window (to guarantee it lands inside the fight) or delayed until Q/E are already looping, given only one R cast fits regardless?
How many of Final Chapter's 5 waves are assumed to hit a stationary single-target dummy, given the ability's directional/geometric hit mechanics?
